newsitem.title: UK: Algeria lowers gas oil price in Dec - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria lowers gas oil price in Dec - trade.

text.p: State Algerian oil company Sonatrach has lowered its asking price for low sulphur gas oil to be delivered in December, traders said.
They said Sonatrach was looking for a premium flat to the formula, which is based on diesel prices in northern Europe and the Mediterranean.
Sonatrach obtained a $2.50 premium to the formula in November and October.
Some traders said they understood Sonatrach had lowered the December offer by 50 cents after its initial offer triggered a negative reaction from some contract holders.
"It was not received with open arms," one of the traders said.
Sonatrach is expected to deliver seven or eight cargoes in December.
